reconcile.note: Matthew Henry narrows 1 Corinthians 4:5's prohibition to judging hidden motives and future states, leaving the doctrinal discernment 2:15 credits to the spiritual person untouched.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells pairs 1 Corinthians 2:15's 'judgeth all things' against 4:5's 'judge nothing before the time' as flatly opposite verdicts on the same question.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
sides.verseText: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.

sides.snippet: judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes
sides.verseText: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
